notes: Controls matched 5:1 on visit month; RRs are crude, not conditional, so matching is a design step. The 1-in-5 estimate is the reciprocal of the risk difference (arithmetic). Incidence rates per 100 person-months are stated as computed but not reported in the text or table, so count/rate is not listed.
view_issues: The limitations give the data period as January 2020–November 2021, but the methods say March 2020. The 'number of survivors' is the reciprocal of the risk difference (a number-needed-to-harm), yet it is interpreted as a share of survivors. The prepass p_value cue is a false hit: there are no p-values.
